ambient_definitions.matrices: Matrix (Fin N) (Fin r) ℝ is a real N by r matrix. Multiplication sums over the middle index. transpose exchanges row and column. Matrix 1 has Kronecker-delta entries; det is the ordinary finite determinant, with determinant of the empty matrix equal to 1.
ambient_definitions.embedding: Fin r ↪ Fin N is an injective map assigning each of r columns a distinct column position.
ambient_definitions.signFlip: QuantumBlockEncoding.RealIsometryCompletion.signFlip j = Matrix.diagonal (fun i => if i = j then -1 else 1).

ambient_definitions.carrier: PrimitiveBasis N := Fin N → Fin 2. Fin N labels physical wires; a basis ket is a function assigning one bit to each wire. Matrix rows are output labels and columns are input labels.
ambient_definitions.basisEquiv: basisEquiv e has toFun b w = b (e.symm w) and invFun b w = b (e w).
ambient_definitions.permutation_matrix: equivPermutationMatrix E a b := if a = E b then (1 : ℂ) else 0.
ambient_definitions.matrix: matrix e M a b = M (fun w => a (e w)) (fun w => b (e w)).
ambient_definitions.angle: ExactAngle is an exact angle-expression type, including real θ with evaluation θ, rational, piRational, twiceArccosRational, twiceArccosSqrtRational, add, neg and rational scale; eval interprets those expressions in ℝ.
ambient_definitions.gate: PrimitiveGate N has x t, ry t angle, rz t angle, and cx c t distinct, where distinct : c ≠ t. gate e maps every target and control through e, leaves constructor and angle unchanged, and transports distinctness through injectivity.
ambient_definitions.circuit: PrimitiveCircuit N := List (PrimitiveGate N). circuit e c := c.map (gate e). evalPrimitiveCircuit [] = 1 and evalPrimitiveCircuit (g :: c) = evalPrimitiveCircuit c * evalPrimitiveGate g.
ambient_definitions.gate_semantics: X flips its target bit using the bit permutation matrix. CX flips its target if the distinct control bit is 1, and otherwise fixes the bitstring. RY/RZ act by the respective 2 by 2 matrix at the target, with entry zero unless every spectator bit agrees.
ambient_definitions.rotations: standardRyMatrix θ = [[cos(θ/2), -sin(θ/2)], [sin(θ/2), cos(θ/2)]] in ℂ. standardRzMatrix θ has diagonal cos(θ/2)-i sin(θ/2), cos(θ/2)+i sin(θ/2), and zero off-diagonal entries. xMatrix = [[0,1],[1,0]].
ambient_definitions.wire_one_basis: A function Fin 1 → Fin 2 is identified with its value at 0 when writing the local 2 by 2 gate matrix. This only describes the carrier convention, not an additional proposition.
